name: Vahini-20-Factor-Handwriting-Analyser-SBOM
comment: Source dependency inventory: exact npm lockfile packages (including transitive dev tooling), pinned CDN PDF.js, and declared Python core/default-engine dependencies. Unresolved Python ranges are recorded in comments, not as installed versions. This is not a complete container SBOM: Python transitive packages, OS libraries, model weights and optional OCR tiers require an inventory from the built image. Rolling font and hosted-service entries describe runtime integrations.
